comment: Read from the maker's source at commit 7dc3dab, doc/manual.md and src/Warp/Mappings.hpp in the same tree, where the three mappings are written out with the maker's own comments naming who designed each. The cutoff knob is 0 to 1 used as 200 raised to that power times 5Hz. The mode knob is a ChoiceQuantity running 0 to 3 whose displayed value is the integer below it clamped to 2, so it has three positions; the label under it is drawn by the widget and cannot be clicked. The drive knob defaults to fully anticlockwise, which in modes 0 and 1 is the least feedback saturation. The underlying filter's own parameters, frequency, Q, gain, drive, feedback drive and feedback, belong to an internal module and never appear on the panel.
